title: DistServe: Disaggregating Prefill and Decoding for Goodput-optimized Large Language Model Serving
technique: prefill/decode disaggregation onto separate GPUs with per-phase parallelism and resource search and bandwidth-aware placement, driven by a simulator

optimized_metrics.evidence: an effective LLM serving system should balance these needs and maximize per-GPU goodput, defined as the maximum request rate that can be served adhering to the SLO attainment goal (say, 90%) for each GPU provisioned
Given the application's TTFT and TPOT requirements, DistServe co-optimizes the resource allocation and parallelism strategy tailored for each phase
maximum rate that can be served within both TTFT and TPOT constraints on each GPU ... while staying within latency constraints for > 90% of requests
We use SLO attainment as the major evaluation metric. Under a specific SLO attainment goal (say, 90%)

headline_claim.text: DistServe can serve 7.4x more requests or 12.6x tighter SLO, compared to state-of-the-art systems, while staying within latency constraints for > 90% of requests.

reported_metrics.where: Fig 8,9 (vs rate and vs SLO scale)

metric_definitions.definition_quote: the time to first token (TTFT), which is the duration of the prefill phase, and the time per output token (TPOT), which represents the average time taken to generate a token for each request (except for the first token)
metric_definitions.notes: TPOT is per-request average excluding first token; footnote: overall latency = TTFT + TPOT x number of generated tokens

metric_definitions.definition_quote: the maximum request rate that can be served adhering to the SLO attainment goal (say, 90%) for each GPU provisioned
metric_definitions.notes: requests/s per GPU; both TTFT and TPOT SLOs must be met by a request

metric_definitions.definition_quote: attainment (the proportion of requests that meet the SLOs)

slo_spec: per-application TTFT and TPOT thresholds, e.g. chatbot OPT-13B TTFT 0.25 s / TPOT 0.1 s (relaxed for larger models); attainment goal 90% (99% in appendix); 'SLO scale' multiplies thresholds
load_regime: request-rate sweep and SLO-scale sweep; simulator resamples arrival traces
tradeoff_acknowledged: in colocated systems prefill and decode interfere, forcing a TTFT vs TPOT trade-off; disaggregation adds KV transfer overhead (small)
hardware: 4 nodes x 8 A100-80GB NVLink, 25 Gbps cross-node
extractor_notes: Objective is per-GPU goodput (cost per query); attainment/percentile is a parameter of goodput, not a P90 latency target. TTFT/TPOT SLOs are the constraints inside the goodput definition.
